CONFIG_KPROBES.reason: Upstream systemd-nsresourced uses a privileged retire_userns_sysctls kprobe to reclaim namespace policy; disabling probes disables its user namespace interfaces and native VM launch.

CONFIG_KPROBE_EVENTS.reason: The namespace broker attaches its required BPF cleanup probe through the kernel kprobe event interface.

CONFIG_VSOCKETS_DIAG.reason: Native host and guest transport diagnostics require vsock listener discovery.

CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY.reason: Do not generate or embed a new in-worker module-signing authority; OBS signs with the existing project key.

CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_ALL.reason: Modules are signed by the existing off-host OBS signing continuation after Fedora's normal build transformations.

CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS.reason: Retain exactly the two Fedora built-in authorities observed on the approved stock baseline; do not embed the project key or any secureblue signing key.

CONFIG_EFI_SBAT_FILE.reason: Preserve Fedora kernel SBAT generation while signing is handled by the existing OBS continuation.

excluded_patches.patches/trusted-keys.patch: Preserve Fedora's approved built-in trust; do not introduce secureblue's additional signing authorities.
